values.note: Nightly $45 and weekly $270 for 2 adults and 2 children, $5 per extra person a day; monthly $750 with electric, 1-2 adults only, if sites are available. Dogs $5 each a night (two max, breed limits). A fee for charging electric vehicles. The page gives no year. Read 2026-10-22.

values.note: Reservations by phone, 828-397-5700. The 2-night weekend minimum is for advance reservations only: '1 night if available for road traffic call on the way'. A gate code is needed to enter, so call ahead even without a reservation. Cash only for visits under 2 weeks (no cards). No refunds on deposits. Check-in 1 pm, check-out 11 am.

note: Small gated RV park near Hickory on the Henry River, a mile off I-40 exit 119. GPS may send you to Whitener Road, about 10 miles away: the park is on Whitener Drive, with no entry from Cedar Springs Drive. Call ahead for the gate code; one RV through the gate at a time. Catch-and-release pond, river tubing and kayaking. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's site: $45 nightly (2+2), full hookups to 50-amp, 30 sites with pull-throughs, open year-round, 2-night weekend minimum for advance bookings; added military discount, no bathhouse (showers false), free Wi-Fi, phone booking with gate-code access. Max rig 45 ft (note prose) not stated by the operator, left. Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: Long-stay share (judged pass on the published tests): the park sells nights publicly at $45 with a phone, a 2-night weekend minimum only for advance bookings, and 'Monthly $750 ... if sites are available' (monthly limited to 1-2 adults and units under 12 years old). No count of monthly vs nightly sites is published, so test 4 passes by default. Not over the price gate; no gateway within 40 km (Charlotte 74 km); no family stays.
